verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files stored locally, giving users total control and the ability to switch apps easily, so leaving needs no export step. Community users independently confirm owning their files and that notes can outlive the app, and Canvas uses an MIT-licensed open JSON format. Missing for 10: evidence covering the open-ness of non-note data (e.g., Bases definitions, plugin data), and Canvas JSON is noted as less human-readable than Markdown.
